description: This Java class 'JsonArrayValueValidator' validates that a JSON array (parsed from a CharSequence) contains only string items. If validation fails, it throws a 'DittoHeaderInvalidException'. The class follows the singleton pattern and extends 'AbstractHeaderValueValidator'. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers' package.

classes.name: JsonArrayValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton validator class that checks if a CharSequence, when parsed as JSON array, contains only string elements. Throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the provided CharSequence, when parsed as a JSON array, only contains string values. Throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: tryToParseJsonArray
methods.description: Attempts to parse the given String as a JsonArray; throws an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: containsNonStringArrayValues
methods.description: Checks if the JsonArray contains any non-string elements.
